properties.displayName: OJK - Manual attestation for Prepare the Centralised list of approved IP addresses
properties.description: Manual attestation is required to validate Ensure the management interfaces of boundary protection devices are configured to only allow communications from specifically permitted IP addresses, thereby securing access and preventing unauthorized access. (Infra-Security-89).

metadata.Description:
IP Address Whitelisting
1. A centralized list of approved IP addresses is maintained
2. Each cloud platform's native security controls are utilized to enforce the IP whitelist
for more details - refer to Control statement
IP Address Whitelisting
1. A centralized list of approved IP addresses is maintained, including:
- IP ranges of corporate offices
- IP addresses of authorized remote access VPN servers
- Specific IP addresses assigned to key security personnel
2. Each cloud platform's native security controls are utilized to enforce the IP whitelist
metadata.controlTitle: Ensure the management interfaces of boundary protection devices are configured to only allow communications from specifically permitted IP addresses, thereby securing access and preventing unauthorized access.

metadata.description: Enable or disable the execution of the policy
